definitions.explanation: The central position between two points.

notes:
{中|なか} is a fundamental word meaning "inside" or "middle."

TWO MAIN MEANINGS:
1. Inside/within: ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中|なか} (inside the box)
2. Among: ⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中|なか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (among three people)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中|なか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: (location) inside ~
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中|なか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: (action location) inside ~ / among ~
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中|なか}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from inside/among ~

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧: center, middle
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{中|なか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: among them
- {中|なか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to go inside

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧ (outside)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧: center
- ⟦{中間|ちゅうかん}→中間：05458_chuukan⟧: middle, intermediate
- ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧: on the way, midway
